title: Nuplex Industries (Aust) Pty limited - proposed acquisition of Acquos Masterbatch

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Nuplex proposed to acquire the Masterbatch business assets of Acquos, including plant and equipment in Melbourne and Sydney. Nuplex and Acquos both manufacture and supply Masterbatch which is a concentrate used to colour a neutral tone plastic. Masterbatches vary from standard black and white, colours, additive Masterbatches that achieve a functional aspect such as optical brighteners, UV stabilizers and flame retardant and special effects Masterbatches which achieve metallic, fluorescent and transparent effects.
body_sections.Market definition: The parties overlap in the manufacture and supply of Masterbatch. The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in a narrow market for the supply of Masterbatch and a broader market for Masterbatch and Compound. The ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a definitive view regarding market definition as the proposed acquisition was unlikely to raise concerns regardless of the market definition applied.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any relevant market for the following reasons: - the potential for imports to act as a competitive constraint; - barriers to expansion are relatively low; - low customer switching costs; and - the existence of a number of alternative manufacturers with excess capacity which would compete with the merged firm post-acquisition.
